tools.name: phpray_sites
tools.description: List the PHP sites this token can see, with requests, p95 latency and error rate. Start here: every other tool needs a site_id from this list.

tools.name: phpray_overview
tools.description: Headline numbers for one site over a time window: requests, errors, p50/p95/p99 latency, database share and N+1 count. Use this before digging into anything else.

tools.name: phpray_slow_pages
tools.description: The slowest URLs on a site, with request counts and p95, from the request timeseries. Answers "which page is slow".

tools.name: phpray_slow_queries
tools.description: SQL fingerprints ordered by time spent, with call counts and the caller when known. Literals are already masked. Answers "which query is slow".

tools.name: phpray_components
tools.description: Time attributed to each plugin, theme or vendor package on profiled requests. Answers "which plugin is slowing the site down". Empty when function profiling is off.

tools.name: phpray_errors
tools.description: Requests that failed on a site: PHP errors and warnings with file and line where PHP raised one, plus 5xx responses that carry no PHP error. Pass an id to phpray_trace to see what one of them did.

tools.name: phpray_traces
tools.description: Recent requests for a site. Filter with min_ms and status to find the bad ones, then pass an id to phpray_trace.

tools.name: phpray_trace
tools.description: One request in full: wall time split into PHP, database and outbound HTTP, every query, every external call, errors, and the component breakdown when the request was profiled.

tools.name: phpray_compare
tools.description: Two time ranges for one site side by side. Use it to check whether a deployment, a plugin update or a configuration change made things better or worse.

tools.name: phpray_alerts
tools.description: Alerts currently firing across every site this token can see, worst overrun first.
